expected.finding: **[P2]** Markdown links bypass location filtering in [is_location](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:303). For `[details](https://github.com/acme/project/pull/42)`, stripping surrounding punctuation leaves `details](https://...`, which matches neither the URL prefix nor a known directory. Repository and URL fragments therefore remain eligible as topic keywords. Two such findings produce an `acme-details` topic in a reproduction. GitHub file links ending in `#L42` also bypass the extension check. Extract Markdown destinations and handle line fragments before testing locations.
